# @codenhub/toaster

> Experimental browser toasts and native modal dialogs: queued, auto-dismissing
> toast stacks, awaitable confirm/prompt/alert dialogs, accessible by default,
> no framework, no injected styles.

Import `@codenhub/toaster/styles` once, show toasts and dialogs only in a
browser, treat DOM nodes passed as custom content as trusted, and call
`destroy()` on instances you create when their area goes away.

## Documentation

- [Documentation overview](docs/index.md): What the package does and the reading order.
- [Toasts](docs/toasts.md): Kinds of toasts, actions, loading and promise toasts, handles and updates, positions, queueing, timers, errors.
- [Dialogs](docs/dialogs.md): confirm, prompt, alert, results, handles, queueing, labels, dialog instances, toasts under dialogs.
- [Toaster instances](docs/instances.md): Every option and default, per-kind defaults, configure(), destroy(), SSR.
- [Styling](docs/styling.md): Stylesheet, colors with and without @codenhub/styles, presentation classes, size, motion, dark mode, color overrides, CSP.
- [Accessibility and security](docs/accessibility.md): Screen reader announcements, focus, reduced motion, consumer responsibilities, custom content trust.
- [API reference](docs/reference/index.md): Every exported symbol, generated from declarations.
- [Changelog](docs/changelog/index.md): Release history and migration notes.
